📺 The Rookie (2018–Present)

The Rookie follows John Nolan, a 45-year-old man who decides to completely change his life by joining the Los Angeles Police Department after a life-changing experience. As the oldest rookie in his training class, Nolan faces skepticism from fellow officers, demanding supervisors, and the physical and emotional challenges of police work. Determined to prove that it’s never too late to pursue a dream, he navigates dangerous criminal investigations, high-speed pursuits, unexpected emergencies, and complicated personal relationships. Alongside his fellow officers, Nolan learns that being a police officer requires more than courage—it takes teamwork, patience, quick thinking, and the ability to make difficult decisions under pressure. Combining intense action, suspenseful investigations, heartfelt moments, and entertaining humor, the series explores second chances, friendship, personal growth, and the challenges of protecting a city.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Action • Police Procedural

⭐ IMDb: 8.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~43 minutes per episode • 8 seasons

🎥 Creator: Alexi Hawley

🏆 Recognition: Starring Nathan Fillion, the series became a popular ABC police drama, earning praise for its entertaining characters, action-packed storylines, and balance of humor and emotional storytelling. Its success also inspired the spin-off The Rookie: Feds.

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu • ABC • Amazon Prime Video • Apple TV (digital purchase). Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Rookie is an American police procedural television series created by Alexi Hawley for ABC. The series stars Nathan Fillion, Alyssa Diaz, Richard T. Jones, Titus Makin Jr., Mercedes Mason, Melissa O'Neil, Eric Winter, Afton Williamson, Mekia Cox, Shawn Ashmore, Jenna Dewan, Tru Valentino, Lisseth Chavez, and Deric Augustine. It follows John Nolan, a man in his 40s, who becomes the oldest rookie at the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD). It is based on real-life LAPD officer William Norcross, who moved to Los Angeles in 2015 and joined the department in his mid-40s.
